meta.name: Mandaar 1080p
meta.description: Power corrupts. And the pursuit of power devastates. As the battle for Geilpur reaches its peak, thirst for power overpowers human conscience in this tragic tale of greed, lust and prophecies!

videos.title: Hell Is Murky
videos.overview: Dablu Bhai calls upon his trusted aide, Mandaar, to curb the forces of dissent against his authority. On his way back after getting the work done, Mandaar meets the eerie Majnu Buri, who seems to soothsay his future.

videos.title: Blood Will Have Blood
videos.overview: While Mandaar and Bonka remain underground, Muqaddar Mukherjee takes stock of Geilpur's power dynamics. The arrival of an unexpected guest makes Laili swear revenge.

videos.title: The Way To Dusty Death
videos.overview: The fathers of Geilpur try to secure their sons' lives and futures. Mandaar and Laili have a vicious plan of their own.

videos.title: Life's But A Walking Shadow
videos.overview: Mandaar pawns the power behind his throne in a desperate attempt to maintain stability. Majnu Buri's prophecy makes him go on another killing spree.

videos.title: Fair Is Foul, And Foul Is Fair
videos.overview: Wracked with guilt and paranoia, Mandaar and Laili descend into the realm of madness. How will the battle for the throne of Geilpur culminate?
